pla-01.prompt: Flat two-dimensional educational illustration. Simple closed shapes, clear dark outlines, completely solid uniform fills. No gradients, shading or texture. The pronoun HE. Two complete standing adults. A woman on the left wearing a light gray sweater extends her arm and points her index finger sideways at a man on the right wearing a bright orange top and blue trousers. The man faces the viewer, her finger distinctly targets him across the gap. Full figures and shoes, no other items, arrows or symbols. Single square CACE vocabulary image. Pure white background. Show every subject and essential prop whole inside the middle two thirds of the canvas. Zoom OUT, leave one sixth of canvas width empty at both sides, generous white above and below. Natural anatomically correct hands. Plain shoes and clothing. No border. Absolutely no text, writing, letters, numbers, labels, brand marks, emblems, logos or watermarks anywhere.
